lfortran_defects_verified.defect: SOURCE= and MOLD= shaped allocation without explicit dimensions is rejected
lfortran_defects_verified.standard_basis: R930 defines both MOLD = source-expr and SOURCE = source-expr. C943 permits no explicit bounds when source-expr appears with the same rank. 9.7.1.2 p7: 'the array is allocated with the shape of source-expr, and with each lower bound equal to the corresponding element of LBOUND(source-expr).' p9 adds for MOLD: 'If MOLD= appears and source-expr is a variable, its value need not be defined.'
lfortran_defects_verified.frozen_lfortran_0_65_0_411: source_shape_bounds: 'ASR verify pass error: Allocate for arrays should have dimensions specified ... ASR_FUZZ_FAILURE phase=pass pass=array_op'. mold_undefined_value: 'semantic error: Allocate for arrays should have dimensions specified ... Array specification required in allocate statement'

lfortran_defects_verified.defect: The SOURCE= expression is evaluated more than once
lfortran_defects_verified.standard_basis: 9.7.1.2 p8: 'The source-expr is evaluated exactly once for each execution of an ALLOCATE statement.' This is an EXPLICIT requirement, not a processor latitude. The integrator specifically challenged whether single evaluation might be latitude - given the standing precedent that evaluation counts are usually unobservable - and the reviewer settled it by quoting the sentence verbatim.
lfortran_defects_verified.gfortran_16_1_0_f2023: ALLOCATE EXECUTION SOURCE EVALUATED ONCE OK

xfail_discipline.rule: A genuine compiler defect is recorded as an XFAIL, never worked around, and only after the required result is HAND-DERIVED FROM THE SOURCE. Compiler consensus is not an oracle - gfortran passing is corroboration, never proof.
xfail_discipline.process_followed: The reviewer was required to quote the exact standard sentence for each defect BEFORE any XFAIL was considered, and to state for each whether it was a genuine compiler defect or a DEFECTIVE TEST. Both were adjudicated genuine defects.
xfail_discipline.reproduced_by_integrator: Yes - the integrator ran the frozen target independently and observed exactly 3 FAIL / 7 PASS, matching the reviewer.
xfail_discipline.sequence: full suite gate (1010 OK) -> --record-execution-review -> --update-xfail, as separate operations. --update-xfail was never combined with a review recording.
xfail_discipline.baseline_movement: 807 -> 810 lines, exactly three additions and no modifications to any existing line.
xfail_discipline.note_on_format: One new XFAIL comment embeds a temporary fixture path. This matches established practice: 121 pre-existing baseline lines carry such paths, and only the case id before the # is significant.

source_derivations_independently_confirm.source_bounds_rule: SOURCE=s with s(-3:-1,5:8) yields LBOUND(a)=[-3,5], NOT unit lower bounds, by 9.7.1.2 p7 together with p1 allocation bounds for s. This was flagged as the claim most likely to be backwards and it is correct.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.bound_capture: The fixture redefines lo=-5 and hi=9 BEFORE the assertions; p1 establishes that later redefinition does not affect already-allocated bounds.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.zero_extent: p1 gives zero extent when the upper bound is below the lower; 9.7.1.3 p1 makes ALLOCATED(a) true after ALLOCATE. No element is read.
source_derivations_independently_confirm.mold_undefined: The MOLD= fixture never reads mold or the undefined content of a; only the fresh writes 612 and 445 are read. Undefined values are not observable and reading one would have been a blocking defect.

non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION targeting the FEATURE UNDER TEST, not merely its oracle.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.author_campaign: 273 mutations: 200 oracle guards, 20 output/omission, 42 input, 11 feature-level.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.reviewer_reran: ALL 273 generated mutations - 273/273 killed, including all 11 feature-level ones.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.reverse_mutation: Scalar source control (source=7 -> 8 with the oracle updated) passed, proving the sentinel load-bearing.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.allocate_specific_guard: Every fixture asserts LBOUND and UBOUND, not merely SIZE, so a processor allocating the wrong bounds is rejected. ALLOCATED(a) alone would not have been sufficient.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.sentinel_discipline: No payload sentinel is 0 - freshly allocated memory is frequently zero, so a zero payload would be vacuous. Zero appears only for the standard STAT=0 and SIZE=0 and for counters and indices.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.bounds_discipline: Non-unit and negative lower bounds (3:5, -2:2, -3:-1, -6:-4) with distinct extents, so defaulted, transposed or off-by-one bounds are all detectable.

observability_limits_respected: No TRANSFER, LOC or address-based oracle; storage layout and allocation mechanism are not observable.
No undefined value or undefined association status is read.
No ERRMSG text, sentinel, inequality or substring oracle (SER-005).
No resource-exhaustion STAT= test: deliberately failing an allocation by requesting a huge array is not portable.
explicit_limitations: Thirteen facets of 9.7.1.2 only; the majority of the section remains pending.
Coarray, team and error paths are not exercised.
Polymorphic ancestor allocation and the undefined-source boundary remain pending.
Three cases FAIL under the frozen LFortran and are recorded as XFAILs. They are NOT evidence of conformance under that toolchain; they are evidence of defects in it.
Passing under gfortran is corroboration, not proof of universal conformance.
Source accounting is unchanged: declared_facets remains 7184.
